new: Subtitles are each headset's own: its menu's Subtitles row (Settings, or the limited page) switches only that headset.

In a shared room the Shared dialog sets the room's default, Subtitles at the start: on / off (also on a full menu's Circles tab). Every headset shows the default until it changes its own; changing the default takes every headset back to it.

A headset's own choice in a room is never sent or kept: it is forgotten when the headset joins or leaves a room or its session starts or ends. Outside rooms the device keeps its own setting, as before (#subs=on|off sets it).
Rooms from before this release are refused (a new room format), so update every device for an event.
Still to try from v214: the limited menu in shared rooms and the staff unlock (both sticks held down for 2 seconds).
